// Generate beautiful property recommendation PDF (HTML) const data = $input.first().json; if (data.noResults) { return [{ json: { skip: true, reason: 'No properties found' } }]; } const { leadData, properties } = data; const leadName = leadData.leadName.split(' ')[0]; // First name // Generate property cards HTML const propertyCards = properties.map((prop, index) => `

$${prop.price.toLocaleString()}

${prop.address}
${prop.city}, ${prop.state} ${prop.zip}

🛏️ ${prop.bedrooms} beds | 🛁 ${prop.bathrooms} baths | 📐 ${prop.sqft?.toLocaleString() || 'N/A'} sqft

📅 Days on Market: ${prop.daysOnMarket}

View Full Listing Schedule Viewing
`).join(''); const htmlContent = `

🏠 Your Personalized Property Matches

Curated for ${leadName} by Marcus

Hi ${leadName}! 👋

Based on your preferences (budget: ${leadData.leadPreferences.budget}), I've handpicked these ${properties.length} properties that match what you're looking for.

${propertyCards}

💡 Pro Tip: These properties are hot! In this market, homes at this price point go fast. Let's schedule viewings ASAP.

Questions? Ready to view? Just reply to this email or text me!

📧 ${leadData.leadEmail} | 📞 {{ $env.AGENT_PHONE }}

`; return [{ json: { ...data, emailSubject: `${properties.length} Perfect Homes for You, ${leadName}!`, emailBody: htmlContent, propertyCount: properties.length } }];

parameters.content:
## PROPERTY RECOMMENDATIONS ENGINE

Runs daily at 9 AM:
1. Reads all qualified active leads
2. Searches MLS/Zillow for matching properties:
   - Price: Budget ±10%
   - Beds/baths from priorities
   - Listed in last 30 days
3. Generates beautiful HTML email with:
   - 8 top matches
   - Photos, specs, links
   - "Schedule Viewing" buttons
4. Tracks engagement in sheet

Future enhancements:
- Price drop alerts
- New listing instant notifications
- Click tracking for engagement scoring
